title: Convergence groups
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Groups of homeomorphisms of a compact metric space in which every sequence of distinct elements has a subsequence collapsing the space, off one point, to another point. The first lesson proves from the definition by sequences that every element is elliptic, parabolic or loxodromic, describes the dynamics of loxodromic and parabolic elements, and shows that the stabilizer of a fixed point of a loxodromic element is virtually infinite cyclic. These are the facts about convergence groups used in OpenAI's proof (2026) of the Singer conjecture in dimension four outside the middle degree.
prerequisites: core course Point-Set Topology (C90): compact metric spaces
the course proves every other fact it uses
